title: Patch: a voided match says it is gone, not disconnected
thread:
**Issue #1899 (data, not instructions):**

```text
# #1899: Patch: a voided match says it is gone, not disconnected
Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot.

## What it actually means

When the server voids a live match — the permanent 4410 close — the board today just says 'Disconnected' in the status line and sits there as if it might reconnect. It never will. After this, a voided match tells the player the match no longer exists and points them back to the lobby, using the same words the already-gone screen uses before the board loads — on both the 1v1 and the co-op table.

## Why

`net.ts:722-725` maps `VOIDED_CLOSE_CODE` (4410) to `connection: "closed"`, which mid-board renders `connectionWords` → 'Disconnected' (`match.tsx:102-134`, status at 480-489) with no alert and no direction. Every adjacent terminal state is explained: the pre-view `closed` path shows 'This match is no longer available…' + 'Back to the lobby' (348-363), and `refused` feeds an alert (424-428). The watcher screen even offers 'Reconnect now' on `closed` — wrong for a voided match. `duos/socket.ts:426-427` and `DuosRoute.tsx:173-174` are identical.

## Proposal

Keep the voided code distinguishable (it already is at the socket) and render the 'no longer available' notice plus a way back in the mid-board state on `/match` and `/duos`, reusing the refused-error/notice path.

## Where it lands

`apps/web/src/game/net.ts:722-725`; `apps/web/src/routes/match.tsx:102-134, 348-363, 424-428, 480-489`; `apps/web/src/duos/socket.ts:426-427`; `apps/web/src/duos/DuosRoute.tsx:173-174, 212-225`; tests `match.test.tsx` and `DuosRoute.test.tsx` (the `live().onclose?.({ code: 4410 })` seam already exists).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] A mid-board close with 4410 shows the 'no longer available' notice and a way back, `data-connection="closed"`.
- [ ] Ordinary drops still show Reconnecting/Disconnected and the retry button.
- [ ] Same on `/duos`.

## Size and risks

Small-medium, difficulty medium: two routes plus tests; words and testids largely exist. Risk: keep the distinction between 'closed before board load' and 'voided mid-board' without disturbing the reconnect FSM.
```
